name: croc_lunge_rising
description: Diagram lunge: a saltwater crocodile rising out of the water up and to the LEFT toward a low branch: head and the front third of the body out of the water, jaws CLOSED, front legs tucked; the rest of the body and the sweeping tail are a dark olive shape under the surface; white splash collar and drops at the waterline. Never the whole body in the air. Anchor centre on the waterline; bbox x -350..300, y -330..160.
